title: Lesson 28 - Let's Go Over It Once More

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Before we finish, let's go over it once more.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Here's what we've decided. I'll finish the text changes by eleven today and send both file formats to Aisha.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I've already prepared the layout. Once Daniel's files arrive, I'll complete the accessibility check by one.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Good. Who's responsible for sending the files to the review group?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I thought you were handling that after my check.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: You're right. I'll send them to the five reviewers by two.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: The feedback deadline is noon tomorrow, correct?

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Correct. If all five reviewers reply by noon, Daniel and Aisha can make the final changes Friday afternoon.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: And if someone hasn't replied yet?

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: I'll follow up at eleven thirty. At noon, we'll use the feedback we've received and record anything still missing.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Then the full release is Monday at nine.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Should the summary name the final version too, so nobody opens yesterday's file?

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Yes. I'll include the version number and links to both formats.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Exactly. I'll send a summary after this call. Is there anything I've missed?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Add that I confirm both the document and PDF before you contact the reviewers.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Got it. Six action items, clear owners or handoffs, and clear deadlines.
